content: All datasets shown in Tab. SECREF2 were transcribed manually by trained transcriptionists, employing the same list of annotations and protocols, with the same set of features extracted from the transcripts (see Sec. SECREF3 ). HAPD and HAFP are jointly referred to as HA.
